name: Sylvan Domain
body:
Granted Powers: You can become one with the forest to learn about its flora and fauna and are divinely blessed with the secrets of fey magic.

Mushroom Magic (Sp)

You can use mushroom magic in one of two ways. As a standard action, you can touch a creature to grant it a number of temporary hit points equal to 1/2 your cleric level (minimum 1) which last for 3 rounds or until they are used up, whichever comes first. Alternatively, you can target a foe within 30 feet and make a ranged touch attack. If the attack is successful, the target gains the sickened condition for 1 round. On the following round, the creature suffers the confused condition for 1 round. (This is a poison effect.) You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.

Wielder of Fey Magic (Ex)

At 8th level, choose one of the creatures below. (This choice is permanent and can’t be changed.)

You can cast the same type of magic as that creature. Just as you can “lose” any prepared spell or domain spell to spontaneously cast a “cure” spell, you can also “lose” any prepared spell or domain spell to spontaneously cast the spells listed at the designated levels matching your selection.

Cold Rider: 1st-obscuring mist, 2nd-chill metal, 3rd-phantom steed, 4th-freedom of movement
Dryad: 1st-charm person, 2nd-tree shape, 3rd-speak with plants, 4th-summon nature’s ally IV
Erlking: 1st-protection from energy, 2nd-whispering wind, 3rd-plant growth, 4th-black tentacles
Elf: 1st-blend, 2nd-whispering lore, 3rd-summon nature’s ally III, 4th-ward of the season
Leprechaun: 1st-shillelagh, 2nd-invisibility (self only), 3rd-major image, 4th-major creation
Muse: 1st-timely inspiration, 2nd-calm emotions, 3rd-glibness, 4th-modify memory
Nereid: 1st-nereid’s grace, 2nd-summon nature’s ally II, 3rd-suggestion, 4th-control water
Nymph: 1st-produce flame, 2nd-resist energy, 3rd-call lightning, 4th-dimension door
Oceanid: 1st-speak with animals, 2nd-summon nature’s ally II, 3rd-water breathing, 4th-control water
Rusalka: 1st-entangle, 2nd-fog cloud, 3rd-water walk, 4th-charm monster
Satyr: 1st-sleep, 2nd-summon nature’s ally II, 3rd-suggestion, 4th-fear
Swan Maiden: 1st-entangle, 2nd-glitterdust, 3rd-deep slumber, 4th-confusion

Domain: 1st-faerie fire, 2nd-wood shape, 3rd-burst of nettles, 4th-neutralize poison, 5th-commune with nature, 6th-transport via plants, 7th-fairy ring retreat, 8th-fey form IV , 9th-summon nature’s ally IX.

Special: This domain is available to druids through their Nature Bond class feature.

Into the Wilds: Sylvan Domain, © 2024, Bloodstone Press; Designer Beth Jones
